responsibility: This file implements GCC’s simple post-reload cleanup optimization pass over hard-register RTL. It performs cselib-based simplification and deletion of redundant sets and no-op moves, simplifies operands of insns and parallels after hard-register assignment, runs reload-specific combine logic, and includes the move2add transformation that recognizes constant/register-plus-constant chains and rewrites moves into arithmetic when profitable. It is the general postreload CSE/combine cleanup pass, distinct from the separate postreload GCSE load-elimination pass.
